summary:
ASTRAHEALTH AI is an autonomous, offline-first clinical intelligence platform designed for deep-space exploration missions (such as Artemis and Mars transit) where light-speed communication latency—up to 22 minutes each way—makes real-time telemedicine from Houston physically impossible.

Operating 100% locally on flight laptops without cloud connectivity, ASTRAHEALTH continuously analyzes astronaut telemetry and daily conversational check-ins against personal dynamic baselines rather than terrestrial population averages. Built upon a strict "Safety Before AI" architecture, deterministic clinical rules based on NASA-STD-3001 govern severity triage, while an on-device local model generates grounded explanations validated by an automated factual guard. 

Featuring multi-signal anomaly detection, personalized recovery care plans, and an air-gapped network guard, ASTRAHEALTH provides reliable clinical self-reliance to astronauts in deep space, with immediate spin-off value for remote polar stations, submarines, and underserved rural clinics on Earth.
details:
ASTRAHEALTH AI

What It Does & How It Works

ASTRAHEALTH AI is an offline health monitoring system designed to support astronauts during long space missions. It monitors vital signs, collects daily health updates, and helps identify unusual changes in an astronaut's health.

The system uses personalized health data instead of general health averages. It also uses multiple AI agents to monitor different areas, including heart health, sleep, nutrition, and mental performance.

Its main feature is a safety-first approach. Medical alerts are generated through predefined rules, while AI helps explain the results in simple language. It also provides health suggestions and a 2D/3D digital view of the human body.

Benefits & Intended Impact

  • Works offline without depending on an internet connection.
  • Helps monitor astronauts' health during long missions.
  • Reduces dependence on immediate communication with Earth.
  • Helps identify unusual health changes early.
  • Can also be useful in submarines, research stations, and remote healthcare facilities.

Hardware, Languages & Tools Used

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS.
  • Backend: Python, FastAPI.
  • Database: SQLite.
  • AI & Analytics: NumPy, Qwen 2.5, Ollama.
  • Visualization: Three.js, Recharts.
  • Testing: Pytest, Playwright.

How It Is Creative & Innovative

The main innovation is that ASTRAHEALTH AI focuses on safety before artificial intelligence.

Instead of allowing AI to make medical decisions independently, it uses predefined medical rules to assess health conditions.

Another unique feature is its personalized baseline system, which compares current health data with an astronaut's previous records while excluding the latest 72 hours.

Key Factors Considered

  • Offline Functionality: Designed to work without internet access.
  • Privacy: Protects sensitive astronaut health information.
  • Performance: Designed to run on limited hardware without requiring a GPU.
  • Reliability: Uses predefined rules and verified references to make health monitoring more dependable.
